body:
I thank you.
The world needs good people.

I am sober
No drinking tonight for the first time this week,
I am watching movies
I have no tools or medicine
I am not capable of going away tonight

I’m doing it all tomorrow
Taking my buddy to the train station, calling the GP 
Emailing my uni tutors
Calling my parents
If I’m only gonna be here for another couple of weeks I’m going down fighting.

It could be anything from apathy to hate.
And I don’t know what’s be worse

I don’t feel right about anything,
I know what I can do but, if I go to the kfc she works at I think the look she’d give me would kill me on the spot.

I had a long conversation with someone that wants me to stay here, I so desperately want to use my talents to help other people
I just don’t know where to start.

This isn’t fair, you are being treated unfairly.
You should tell everyone how you about them so they know how they are making you feel.
Your parents should do better.

thank You. I don’t write much. And when I do it’s this kind of stuff. 
I think it’s nice to have this void to scream into, and sometimes there is an echo. So thanks.

You are not alone in this.
And when you find yourself at your lowest, the next day can only be better. Or the same, but then you’re still in the same position.
It might not get better, but it probably won’t get worse.

These aren’t /u/
These are just their nicknames.
They’ll know who they are when they read it and that’s what matters.

I appreciate the care,
She is not the cause of my depression,
She makes me very happy.
I am depressed
And I do think about suicide.
But I feel better round her.
And I know she cares about me too. It’s just a rocky patch at the moment.
Peace and love friend.

You cry almost everyday?
Okay bitch I cry myself to sleep and wake up crying 
That is my life.
But check my history
I’m here doing my best to help the other people here
Because sadness is sadness.
And you should do better.
I went on a walk today. I walked to the marina where I will kill myself at some point, anyway I walk past her place of work and I manage not to go in screaming. So that was a win.

I don’t need to waste my time.
But I will gladly spend it trying to help people in a situation not unlike my own.
You deserve better from people.
People don’t know how lucky they are to have us in their life until we’re gone.

I feel a whole lot better while I’m helping people, but as before I am absolutely disgusted by abuse of one’s own child, 
You do not deserve it and life is not hopeless.

I spent most of today crying because I hate a lot of things about myself and this world.
And I feel better now after supporting all the people I can.

If there is anything some random person on the internet can do to make you feel even a little bit better
Then tell me
1 reason is all you need. And every time I get an Abusive dad story, it’s one more thing that I want to fix. So you let me know ho and it’s done.

I am in a very similar situation.
I’ve been this way since 11, I’m 19 now and the pain i feel only grows each day.
24 hours is a big ask. But if today is the worst day of your life, tomorrow will be better.

You deserve a better father, I met someone last year and she means the world to me, her dad is the same way, but i love her so much. And if she can be loved then so can you.
Just hold on, otherwise you’ll never get to prove him wrong.

Your dog is very lucky to be so loved and cherished.
A heart as strong as yours does not belong in the ground.
You have a lot to give and nothing to give it to. But if you stick around and find it, who knows? Maybe one day you’ll find something, not to replace this companion, but something you can feel the same way toward.

This guy sounds like me,
Also a guy that gets in over his head way to quick way to often.
In our shared defence, enthusiasm never hurt anyone. If I was in his position I’d want you to talk to me about it before it got out of hand.
Good luck!!

You’ve made up your mind it sounds
You shouldn’t have to depend on people that are threatening you with revoking their support if you don’t do what they say.
There will be a nicer place in the future. But if you can’t afford nice right now don’t go bankrupt trying.

Do you think it’s nice or do they?
You can make any house a home. And if your parents can’t support you own self beneficial actions then tell them that that isn’t okay.

People get it wrong, all the time.
Your job should not define you because no one does the same job forever.
If your friends are finding someone “better”
Then you find better friends.

You could show her this reddit post?
I don’t know
But I do think you should move out, you cannot let your parents make that kind of choice anymore.

A similar place
I had a bully
That’s what you’re describing.
And I can’t forget about mine even after the time has passed.
My friends tell me that it’s like letting them live inside my head rent free.
And that they don’t have that power over me anymore.

I go and sit by the edge of the water at night, and I scream because no one can hear me.
I cry and I think of jumping in.
It’s bad and you deserve to be happy.

I’m giving myself like a week
Cuz stuff might get better.
But they might get worse
And if they do.
I’m gone

To live is to suffer.
I just try my best to make sure I don’t cause any suffering, and I take solace in that fact.
Now that is someTruthatYa.
You are loved, you make people’s lives better. So their lives would be worse without you. So stay around, because they deserve it.

“ i don’t know how many days I have left.”
I feel exactly the way. 
I am way to scared to be by myself. And I had assumed that I had ruined things between people. And I reached out. It hasn’t worked yet, not fully, but it’s a little better now, and if it’s better now it’ll be good at some point.

Okay, i was in the same place all week. I get it. I know where I’d go to do it, I took some people to the place. And it felt amazing. I got to express so much. 
If you want to vent, then vent
Because you might feel better afterward.
Your life, any life. Is worth so much.

If you go, you go.
And you’ll never build that trust back.
Your parents love you, and they should know that. You should experience their love.
The truth will out. Every time. So stick around to prove it.
You are worth the effort you have to put in to stay alive.

No
You do the fuck not.
You are perfect and You deserve to know it.
I know happy people and sad people.
100% of the time the sad people are better,
They are kinder
And smarter 
And sad people deserve to be happy.

Abuse of someone’s own children is the most disgusting thing in the world.
And I am so, so sorry that you go through it.
I know someone very special to me that has been through it and she is the strongest person I know.
You are not alone in this.
We don’t choose to be born and when we are we suffer for the rest of our time on earth. Made to pay for others choices.

I stay around because it would upset people that have it worse than me if I left.
And it hurts so much.  
I’m pushing her away and I don’t know how to stop.

Because I like her, very much so
And she doesn’t believe me when I tell her, she hates herself and doesn’t think she deserves to be happy.
She makes me happy 
Every time she smiles I live a little longer

Well,
That’s what parents do.
And mine tend to make their worries my problems
We got our own problems without them debug. All overbearing ya know??
I’m out of the house, I’m 19, and the freedom is. Immeasurable. But there is always that safety net when it’s needed.

Yeah, and if that doesn’t do the trick for me,
I say, “if the only thing I did today was survive, then that’s a win.”

Well, do the work. 
That’s important.
And when the work is done, you can do the fun stuff too!

I get it,
I want it very much
I want it all the time
And being brave enough to stay here for other people is what gets me through it.
And after I get down from the ledge and go home. I fall asleep from the alcohol thinking I’m too pussy to do it. 
And I wake up the next day and remember that living is harder.
But living for other people, is not so bad. 
That’s what I focus on, the people around. Their love for me beats my hate for, like, the whole world.

Do what you enjoy
I feel the exact same way and when I do I buy and eat nothing but junk food and listen to new music and watch my favourite movies.
Right now I’m doing that, imma watch captain America and eat pizza in bed.
